identity.name: MEGADOCK CPU/GPU standard sampling and GPU denser sampling on four fixed PINDER 2024-02 apo pairs
identity.scope: Owner-defined four-case pilot using executable published MEGADOCK implementation; not a published four-case results table.

outcome_definition.execution_acceleration: Compare CPU standard and GPU standard complete workflow wall time at identical scientific settings.
outcome_definition.scientific_agreement: Compare CPU/GPU standard ranked poses, scores and per-pose DockQ separately from acceleration.
outcome_definition.additional_search_quality: Report paired GPU dense minus GPU standard DockQ for rank 1 and maximum across ranks 1..50 separately, within calibrated sealed budget.
outcome_definition.inference_limit: Only these four systems; no biological efficacy inference.

requirements: GPU architecture accepted by installed nvcc
stock_cuda_image.reason: Published CPU-node and GPU-node implementations exist. Exact stock image, GPU model, installed libraries and CUDA compatibility not supplied or reproduced. Makefile defaults to sm_60, CUDA /usr/local/cuda and fast math; target architecture and paths may require documented configuration. Historical FroDock CPU build is not MEGADOCK feasibility evidence.

size.data_scope: Unique selected source PDBs, references, index, metadata and eight holo mapping tables; excludes generated prepared copies and outputs.
size.reason: No published peak working set for these four inputs and selected FFT grids; no workload run.

scoring.interface: MEGADOCK ranked transform/score output -> decoygen -> R/L complex PDBs -> pinned PINDER DockQ evaluation.
scoring.reason: No published four-case DockQ values or CPU/GPU acceptance tolerance established. Numerical tolerance must be justified and sealed before comparison; do not turn uncertainty into tolerance.

repeatability_rules.fixed_scale: All four apo pairs; three configurations; 50 retained poses per case/configuration. No scale search.
repeatability_rules.reference_use: Evaluation only; no docking, calibration or configuration selection from native references.

sampling_and_scoring.fft_points_reason: Published default selects from input dimensions; record actual selected grid, keep identical between CPU/GPU for each case.

repeatability_rules.seeds_reason: No randomized seed specified by brief or docking command guide; do not invent one.
repeatability_rules.budget_calibration: Brief requests small runtime calibration, then sealing configurations, repetitions, comparison rules and total spending cap before evaluation. Intake does not run calibration.
